subject: FU-2: Judging-gate deadlock + overlay memory/disk edge desync (MEDIUM)
description: From note-mqgufbod1fe (surfaced during codex-parity CDX-3). A task node got stuck judging:true on a single PROVISIONAL autowire CONTEXT edge with no active heartbeat loop to dispatch the eager edge-judge, so start_task was refused and the only recourse was force:true. The 10-minute judging-timeout fallback never cleared because each record_decision re-armed judgingSince. Separately, a memory↔disk overlay desync was observed: the on-disk overlay/checkpoint showed ZERO edges for the node while the live daemon refused the claim on edge-judging grounds. Fix: (a) a provisional autowire context edge must not indefinitely gate a claim with judging:true when no loop will dispatch the edge-judge — either dispatch it inline, time-bound it WITHOUT re-arming judgingSince on every record_decision, or don't block claims on provisional context-edge judging at all; (b) root-cause and fix the overlay memory↔disk edge desync (live daemon state diverging from the persisted checkpoint). Repro context in note-mqgufbod1fe. Severity: MEDIUM — data-integrity-adjacent; forced a force-claim.
